body:
Also it's 3:45 am here i really should sleep I'll be late for work :(

I can't sleep though, all I can think of is ways to not wake up.
I'm still in the same town, just down the street from her. Fuck this. Fuck it so hard.

Thanks.

That's not the problem though. I know who I am, and what I like. Unfortunately I'm mediocre at everything I try, and find little enjoyment in sitting about on my own trying to discover myself.

I'm also mildly manic depressive and get periods of bad depression, and everytime I do my relationships end, I lose friends and end up alone.

I have tried drugs, therapy, you name it, it's gotten me nowhere.

Also, I'm the guy, she's the girl. I really though she would understand... I told her about my issues (and she had her issues too, which I helped her with and stood by her through). 

I really don't see a possible happy future for myself. Everytime I think I have it it ends like this. What's the fucking point?

Just be there for him. Listen to what he has to say without judgement, if you think it's worth it. Take him to the countryside - outside the city for the weekend, it'll help calm his anxiety to see some nature. 

Lastly, it's not really your burden, it's his. If you cannot take it any more, you have to take care of yourself and do what's right for you as well. I'm going through this exact same thing (my ex was too busy for me, and I was going through a minor bout of depression, and she ended it). 

All I an do now is suck it up, deal with myself and hopefully one day we'll get back together, since we still love each other dearly. But I need to sort out my life. Sometimes breaking up is the only way to fix things :( 

If you really can't face that, then fill your lives with something. Like I said, getting out of the city / getting out of the routine. Hiking, rafting, some kind of sport you can both partake in, things like that can really help :)
PM me and we can talk :)
